items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions 'Jimmy King' and describes his work, but the INTERVIEWEE (Lionel Ferbos) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship.

ctx.x: And I write in there when he said about the Davis, I'm going to tell you where, you know Jimmy Davis, the pianist, where he kind of kissed him. His brother was a drummer then. He died of crying and he sang his body. Because I went and seen him there, Lady Mike Lopez, you know Jimmy King. He worked there for years, you know, he did the dance at the La Vida in the front. He worked for years. That's what he did.
What was it like working on the Madisonville? How did that gig work?
